reviews.comment: Many critiques were confusing and misleading. He is very understanding if you participate well in class, but his organization was at times frustrating.

Professor Lu is a sweet guy, but his critiques are not very solid. They change often and made a lot of people restart. However, I had a very challenging group where I ended up sacrificing my health for the project. He stepped up and encouraged me to take a step back for fear that I wouldn't be okay. I didn't because I couldn't, but he cares.
I do not know what to say other than do not take this course.

He called us in over Thanksgiving Break to make changes to the design of our model AFTER pencils down. He had seen these elements for month and had no issue with them until after we were already done with the design and were 3D printing our model. Just incredibly disorganized and unhelpful. I have cried a lot over this class. Do not take him.

I think a lot of students are too harsh on his rating. It's a tough class, but he's not a bad professor. He helps his students and does give critiques. You just have to listen to him. I would say I think that all the studio class professors don't know what needs to be turned in on what specific day

Professor Lu is a very caring professor, who wants his students to do their absolute best. He does critique which can be seen as harsh, but honestly it is inevitable. He does explain out how to improve your designs and just wants you to improve and reach your highest potential. Overall a very great professor, and I would take again.

Awful studio professor. I often show up to class ready to show him the progress I made and he refuses to look at anything that is not on paper. I can have my entire project designed but it wont count for anything just because its on my rhino file and not on a physical piece of paper. He will then tell me I am behind and havent made any progress.

Dude couldn't even remember his own critiques. It's unfair that he made us redo our design to fit his preferences, only to change his mind again. He expected way more drawings than other studios (doesn't even look at them), and calls himself a mental health advocate while being a total hypocrite when it came to his students' well-being.

Lu was placed into 2nd yr studio last minute bc there was a shortage of professors. He is used to teaching third years and masters students but is incapable of adjusting the workflow for second years. He gives extremely unhelpful critiques. He has often told me to restart my entire project last minute without any direction of how to move forward.

To be honest, this was the worst professor I've ever had for studio. He changes his mind every time he critiques everyone's work and makes them restart without providing any guidance. He actively got our studio behind by doing a ton of extra work that ended up not being used or graded. Not only this, he blames us for being behind. DONOTTAKEHIMRUN!!

If you want to have a good time in studio and make good projects. THEN DONT TAKE THIS GUY. Made my group restart constantly without guidance. He always changed his mind about our stuff and I feel like I've lost so much confidence in my skill. I don't know how I'm going to catch up to the other studios next semester.

If I were to drop out of architecture, it would be because of this professor. He is fickle with his critiques and leads your group to end up with a product that you will hate. He got our studio behind because he assigns a ton of extra busy work. He was so unhelpful, and I would have been better without a professor  because I did better on my own.

Project-focused. I watched one lecture all semester and made an A. There's progress meetings every so often on Zoom with him, he offers great constructive criticism. He's not the type to give out straight 100s on everything, and it's particularly hard to study for exams, so be prepared to grind every now and then. DO EXTRA CREDIT!!! Saved my grade.

Lu is great! lectures are pretty common sense, and the class is based around group projects. assigned groups but he's willing to switch things if needed. show up to class its graded. lots of extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Lu is by far my favorite professor yet! His class is set up by weekly modules that are very clear and well laid out. He assigns group projects but is very willing to help rearrange groups if any issues occur. He is so good at providing meaningful feedback during project check-ins that will help bring your grade up. He also is super funny
Really great prof!!! Lots of work, but doable.

Honestly one of my favorite classes this year. He is hilarious and makes the class fun. He gives lots of extra credit if you are willing to try for them but they aren't hard & definitely worth it. The tests are lecture based so show up to class, he does post the notes online but the important info is blacked out. An awesome class to take for a UCC.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: he is a good prof, goes off power points so everything is online. reviews before tests. i studied hard the day before every time and did fine. he will give you feedback if you ask him. seems like he cares. kind of boring, but he is in healthcare architecture so hes really interested in old people. nothing exciting/ pushing architecture in any way
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Group projects
